kebab_example: aliyun pailangstudio create-knowledge-base --workspace-id 47800 --accessibility PUBLIC --name myName --description This_is_a_description_of_the_knowledge_base. --knowledge-base-type TEXT --output-dir oss://test-bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com/langstudio/output/ --data-sources oss://test-bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com/langstudio/source/ --chunk-config ChunkSize=1024 ChunkDuration=30 ChunkOverlap=200 ChunkStrategy=Default --embedding-config ConnectionId=conn-r3o700000038bh Model=text-embedding-v4 --vector-db-config ConnectionId=conn-7y5y000000jja7 CollectionName=my_collection VectorDBType=Milvus --runtime-id rtime-apje000000beaz --meta-data-config '{"CustomMetaData":[{"ValueType":"String","Key":"author"}]}' --index-column-config '{"EmbeddingColumns":["column1"],"ColumnDefinitions":["column1"],"ContentColumns":["column1"]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateKnowledgeBase

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the workspace.

PRIVATE: The workspace is visible only to you and the administrator of the workspace.
PUBLIC: The model is visible to all users in the workspace
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见
parameters.name: accessibility

fields.help_en:
Chunking strategy. Supported strategies are as follows:

Default. System default slicing strategy.
Asr. Split by audio content; valid for video knowledge bases
fields.help_zh:
分块策略。支持的策略如下：
Default。系统默认切片策略。
Asr。按音频内容切分，视频知识库有效
fields.name: chunk_strategy

parameters.example: This is a description of the knowledge base.
parameters.help_en: Custom description of the knowledge base
parameters.help_zh: 对知识库进行自定义描述
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en:
Index service connection ID. For more information about how to obtain the connection ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922801.html. The connection types supported by each type of knowledge base are as follows:

Documents: BaiLian LLM Service, General Embedding Model Service, AI Search Open Platform Model Service.
Structured Data: BaiLian LLM Service, General Embedding Model Service, AI Search Open Platform Model Service.
Images: BaiLian LLM Service, General Multimodal Embedding Model Service.
Videos: BaiLian LLM Service
fields.help_zh:
索引服务连接ID。如何获取连接ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922801.html。
各类型知识库支持的连接类型如下：
文档：百炼大模型服务、通用Embedding模型服务、AI搜索开放平台模型服务。
结构化数据：百炼大模型服务、通用Embedding模型服务、AI搜索开放平台模型服务。
图片：百炼大模型服务、通用多模态Embedding模型服务。
视频：百炼大模型服务
fields.name: connection_id

fields.help_en:
Model name. Specifically, when selecting the BaiLian LLM Service, the models supported by each type of knowledge base are as follows:

Documents: text-embedding-v1, text-embedding-v2, text-embedding-v3, text-embedding-v4
Structured Data: text-embedding-v1, text-embedding-v2, text-embedding-v3, text-embedding-v4
Images: multimodal-embedding-v1
Videos: qwen2.5-vl-embedding
fields.help_zh:
模型名称。特别的，当选择百炼大模型服务时，各类型知识库支持的模型如下：
文档：text-embedding-v1、text-embedding-v2、text-embedding-v3、text-embedding-v4
结构化数据：text-embedding-v1、text-embedding-v2、text-embedding-v3、text-embedding-v4
图片：multimodal-embedding-v1
视频：qwen2.5-vl-embedding
fields.name: model

fields.help_en: Content filtering column. The fields in this list support keyword-based retrieval
fields.help_zh: 内容过滤列。该列表中的字段支持按照关键字进行检索
fields.name: content_columns

fields.help_en: Vector retrieval column. The fields in this list will be vectorized and participate in retrieval
fields.help_zh: 向量检索列。该列表中的字段会进行向量化并参与检索
fields.name: embedding_columns

parameters.help_en: Structured knowledge base field column configuration
parameters.help_zh: 结构化知识库字段列配置
parameters.name: index_column_config

parameters.help_en:
The type of the knowledge base. Specifies whether to disable the instance protection period. Default value: false. Valid values:

TEXT: Document.
STRUCTURED: Structured data.
IMAGE: Picture.
VIDEO: Video
parameters.help_zh:
知识库类型。支持以下取值：
TEXT：文档。
STRUCTURED：结构化数据。
IMAGE：图片。
VIDEO：视频
parameters.name: knowledge_base_type

fields.help_en: Metadata field type. Currently, only the String class type is supported
fields.help_zh: 元数据字段类型。目前只支持String类型
fields.name: value_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the knowledge base. The name must meet the following requirements:

Can contain letters, numbers, or underscores (_).
Starts with a letter.
Length is 1 to 127 characters
parameters.help_zh:
知识库的名称。命名规则如下：
可以包含字母、数字或下划线（_）。
以字母开头。
长度为1~127个字符
parameters.name: name

fields.help_en: Vector database table or collection name
fields.help_zh: 向量库的表或集合名称
fields.name: collection_name

fields.help_en: Vector database connection ID. For more information about how to obtain the connection ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922801.html
fields.help_zh: 向量数据库连接ID。如何获取连接ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922801.html
fields.name: connection_id

fields.help_en:
Vector database type. Supports the following values:

Elasticsearch
Milvus
Faiss (only supported for document and structured data knowledge bases)
fields.help_zh:
向量数据库类型。支持以下取值：
Elasticsearch
Milvus
Faiss（仅文档和结构化数据知识库支持）
fields.name: vector_db_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace. For more information about how to obtain the ID of a workspace, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

WorkspaceId.description_en: The workspace ID of the knowledge base
WorkspaceId.description_zh: 知识库所属的工作空间 ID
